why: the brief and three candidate designs disagreed on which symbols exist
evidence: androidx-main WindowInfoTracker.kt, WindowMetrics.kt, WindowSizeClass.kt, WindowSizeClassSelectors.kt; window-1.5.1.pom

why: the 1:1 goal favors a faithful additive surface over an invented composite snapshot
result: picked C1 + grafts (empty-list emit, one builder for pull/push, idempotent start/stop)

why: androidx.window.layout.WindowMetrics has no insets, and the goal is 1:1
